messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: SimpleQuestion_ask
function.description: Presents a simple question based on the provided context and expects an answer from a predefined set of options. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

question.description: The question posed to the user.

answer.description: The selected answer to the question, which must be one of the provided options.

context.description: The context or scenario in which the question is being asked, providing additional information to the user.

message.content:
Here’s a list of the long weekends (public holidays that fall on a Friday or Monday, creating a three‑day weekend) in Canada for 2023:

| Date | Holiday | Day of Week | Notes |
|------|---------|-------------|-------|
| Jan 1 – Jan 2 | New Year’s Day (observed) | Sunday–Monday | New Year’s Day fell on Sunday, so the holiday was observed on Monday, Jan 2. |
| Feb 20 | Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, Ontario) | Monday | Observed in provinces that celebrate Family Day. |
| Mar 17 | St. Patrick’s Day (Ontario) | Friday | Ontario observes St. Patrick’s Day as a statutory holiday. |
| Apr 7 | Good Friday | Friday | Observed nationwide. |
| Apr 10 | Easter Monday | Monday | Observed in federal institutions and some provinces. |
| May 22 | Victoria Day | Monday | Observed nationwide. |
| Jun 19 | Canada Day (observed) | Monday | Canada Day fell on Saturday, so the holiday was observed on Monday, Jun 19. |
| Jul 1 | Canada Day | Saturday | Observed on the nearest weekday (Mon 3). |
| Jul 3 | Canada Day (observed) | Monday | Observed for the July 1 holiday falling on Saturday. |
| Sep 4 | Labour Day | Monday | Observed nationwide. |
| Oct 9 | Thanksgiving | Monday | Observed nationwide. |
| Nov 7 | Remembrance Day (observed) | Monday | Remembrance Day fell on Sunday, so the holiday was observed on Monday, Nov 7. |
| Nov 10 | Remembrance Day | Thursday | Observed in some provinces. |
| Dec 25 | Christmas Day | Monday | Observed nationwide. |
| Dec 26 | Boxing Day | Tuesday | Observed nationwide. |

These are the dates that create a three‑day weekend (or longer if you include the preceding or following days) for most Canadians in 2023. If you need province‑specific details or additional holidays (e.g., provincial holidays that don’t create a long weekend), let me know!
message.reasoning: The user wants a list of long weekends for Canada in 2023. We need to provide that. The user didn't ask a question that requires the SimpleQuestion_ask function. They just want data. So we can respond with the list. There's no function call needed. Just provide the answer.
